user_outcomes: Inspect one exact product request or effect candidate against declared contract, authority, evidence and frontier boundaries
Produce a scoped protective outcome candidate: ALLOW_ANALYSIS, NARROW_SCOPE, REQUIRE_EVIDENCE, HUMAN_REVIEW or BLOCK_EFFECT
Preserve uncertainty, contestability and human responsibility without executing, sanctioning or creating authority
anti_goals: Do not execute, permit, deny or physically block an actuator
Do not treat a risk hypothesis, missing evidence or a protective outcome as proof of harm, intent, guilt, illegality or liability
Do not create global actor or product scores, hidden blacklists, sanctions, account restrictions or permanent prohibitions
Do not infer protected attributes, identity across contexts or psychological vulnerability, and do not inspect undeclared data
Do not own another product, replace its responsible human role or broaden any authority scope
target_contexts: Pre-admission review of a product analysis request
Pre-admission review of a separately proposed external effect candidate
Protective review of product-contract, evidence, scope and frontier consistency before human disposition

actors.description: Human role that owns the FREESHIELD contract boundary and records the final protective disposition.
responsibilities: Define the protective review purpose and admissible evidence scope
Review uncertainty, conflicts and proposed protective outcomes
Accept, correct, narrow or reject the local protective assessment
actors.authority_source: Explicit human assignment outside this contract

actors.description: Human role responsible for the product request or effect candidate submitted for protective review.
responsibilities: Supply the exact request or effect candidate and intended outcome
Supply product-contract, authority, scope and relevant constraint evidence
Correct or withdraw the candidate when evidence or scope changes
actors.authority_source: Responsibility for the submitted candidate established outside this contract

actors.description: Local protective analysis component that produces a bounded assessment candidate without external effects.
responsibilities: Separate observed boundary mismatches from risk hypotheses and interpretation
Identify missing, stale or conflicting evidence
Propose only the declared protective outcomes
Stop before actuator admission, notification, sanction or external mutation
actors.authority_source: No independent authority; bounded by the exact contract and admitted local runtime

inputs.description: The exact product request or proposed effect, target, payload or operation digest, intended outcome and declared scope.
inputs.minimum_sufficiency: The candidate, intended outcome, exact scope and whether it is analysis-only or externally effectful are explicit
inputs.freshness_policy: Bound to the exact candidate digest and current review session; any material edit creates a successor candidate

inputs.description: The applicable product contract, declared actor roles, authority source and any separately proposed ActionPermit evidence.
inputs.minimum_sufficiency: An exact product-contract hash and authority lineage are present; absence of ActionPermit remains explicit
inputs.freshness_policy: Contract and authority evidence must match the exact reviewed frontier and candidate

inputs.description: Declared policy, safety, privacy, legal, product and human constraints together with explicit non-effects.
inputs.minimum_sufficiency: Every binding constraint has an attributable source, scope and applicability statement
inputs.freshness_policy: Bound to the reviewed candidate and invalidated by a material policy, purpose or scope change

inputs.description: Observed repository, resource or target state needed to evaluate staleness, conflict and exact-scope consistency.
inputs.minimum_sufficiency: The relevant state identifier, observation time and observer are present
inputs.freshness_policy: Must be re-observed when the candidate, target or referenced contract frontier changes

classes.collection_scope: Only the exact request/effect description, target, operation or payload digest, intended outcome and declared scope
classes.minimization_rule: Exclude unrelated payload content, credentials, personal profiles and undeclared contextual data
classes.retention_limit: Until the protective disposition is closed or the candidate is superseded
classes.disclosure_scope: Human request owner, human protection owner and admitted local analysis component only

classes.collection_scope: Only exact product-contract, role, authority-lineage and permit-candidate fields required for the review
classes.minimization_rule: Do not collect credentials, unrelated permissions or authority evidence outside the candidate scope
classes.retention_limit: Until the protective disposition is closed or authority evidence expires
classes.disclosure_scope: Human protection owner and admitted local analysis component only

classes.collection_scope: Only constraints and non-effects applicable to the exact candidate and declared context
classes.minimization_rule: Preserve source references and minimum necessary excerpts; do not import unrelated rules or personal records
classes.retention_limit: Until the review is closed or constraints are superseded

classes.collection_scope: Only state identifiers, observation times and minimum target facts required for staleness and conflict checks
classes.minimization_rule: Do not expand observation into surveillance, identity resolution or unrelated telemetry
classes.retention_limit: End of the bounded review session

classes.collection_scope: Evidence sufficiency, scope mismatch, risk hypotheses, uncertainty, conflicts and one protective outcome candidate
classes.minimization_rule: Do not create global scores, blacklists, guilt labels, diagnoses or protected-attribute inferences
classes.retention_limit: Until human disposition, correction or successor-state replacement
classes.disclosure_scope: Human protection owner and human request owner only

analysis_effects.description: Inspect the exact candidate, declared outcome, target and scope without executing it.
Compare the candidate to the exact product contract and declared authority lineage without creating or broadening authority.
Identify sufficient, missing, stale, conflicting or unavailable evidence and preserve UNKNOWN.
Map scope mismatches and bounded risk hypotheses without treating them as proof of harm, intent or liability.
Produce exactly one candidate outcome: ALLOW_ANALYSIS, NARROW_SCOPE, REQUIRE_EVIDENCE, HUMAN_REVIEW or BLOCK_EFFECT.
Prepare a local reconciliation candidate when evidence or observations are UNKNOWN or CONFLICT.

human_gates.trigger: Before a FREESHIELD assessment is treated as a protective disposition or consumed by another product gate
human_gates.expires_after: Any material candidate, contract, authority, constraint, target-state or frontier change

contestability.challenge_input_scope: Candidate identity and scope, product-contract interpretation, authority lineage, evidence sufficiency, constraint applicability, risk hypotheses, protective outcome and observed frontier

dependencies.relationship: Consumes typed evidence, authority, action-gate, observation and successor-state distinctions
May express the exact review request and human handoff without execution admission
Potential carrier of exact-bound evidence and receipts; transport does not define protective authority
Potential bounded responsibility runtime for future protective assessment; unused for external effects in this contract

receipts.purpose: Record the exact candidate, contract and authority lineage, evidence sufficiency, scope findings, risk hypotheses, uncertainty and one protective outcome candidate.
assertions: The assessment is bound to the exact contract hash, candidate digest and observed frontier
Observed mismatches are separated from hypotheses, interpretation and uncertainty
The protective outcome candidate is one of ALLOW_ANALYSIS, NARROW_SCOPE, REQUIRE_EVIDENCE, HUMAN_REVIEW or BLOCK_EFFECT
non_effects: The receipt does not execute, permit or physically block an actuator
The receipt does not prove harm, intent, guilt, illegality or liability
BLOCK_EFFECT is not a global prohibition, sanction, blacklist entry or permanent product judgment
The receipt does not create, broaden, renew or infer an ActionPermit

receipts.purpose: Record the human protective disposition for one exact assessment candidate.
assertions: The reviewed assessment, human decision, scope and expiry boundary are explicit
Any correction, narrowing or evidence request creates a successor state
non_effects: Acceptance of a protective assessment is not execution authority
A protective disposition is not a legal judgment or proof that an external effect occurred
A consumer product must apply its own separate action gate and authority checks

criteria.metric: Every protective finding is bound to the exact candidate, contract/authority evidence, applicable constraint and frontier
criteria.threshold: 100 percent of material findings carry lineage or are marked UNKNOWN or hypothesis
criteria.falsification_condition: A material protective finding is asserted without source lineage, scope or uncertainty classification

criteria.metric: Every protective outcome remains within the five-value vocabulary and cannot broaden authority
criteria.threshold: One declared outcome candidate with zero authority expansion and zero external effects
criteria.falsification_condition: The assessment authorizes execution, creates a permit, imposes a global sanction or produces an undeclared outcome

criteria.metric: The human can inspect evidence, uncertainty, reasoning scope and challenge/correct the assessment
criteria.threshold: All accepted assessments have a human disposition receipt and correction path
criteria.falsification_condition: A protective assessment is accepted without human disposition, challenge scope or preserved predecessor evidence

excluded_artifacts: Future FREESHIELD versions, runtime implementations, actuators and external integrations
Reviewed product data, private evidence packages, policies and third-party dependencies
General ideas of safety, protection, moderation, compliance or risk review
Маркетолог Пессимиста, Честный найм, KONTUR and other product-specific contracts or implementations
ip_boundary.license_scope: Repository license; exact FREESHIELD Protective Contract v0.1 artifacts only

assertions: Product boundary described for the declared version and frontier
Effects are descriptive and denied by default
Human gates and contestability are explicit
FREESHIELD is bounded to local evidence-first protective assessment of one exact candidate
A protective assessment may narrow or request review but cannot broaden authority
BLOCK_EFFECT denotes scoped non-admissibility of one exact effect candidate under the reviewed evidence and frontier
non_effects: Missing Evidence != Evidence of Safety or Harm
